uq_bank_accounts_bank_nomor.name: uq_bank_accounts_bank_nomor
uq_bank_accounts_bank_nomor.where: "bank_accounts"."nama_bank" IS NOT NULL AND "bank_accounts"."nomor_rekening" IS NOT NULL

ck_bank_accounts_rekening_bank_lengkap.name: ck_bank_accounts_rekening_bank_lengkap
ck_bank_accounts_rekening_bank_lengkap.value: "bank_accounts"."jenis" <> 'BANK' OR ("bank_accounts"."nama_bank" IS NOT NULL AND "bank_accounts"."nomor_rekening" IS NOT NULL)

ck_bank_transactions_lawan.name: ck_bank_transactions_lawan
ck_bank_transactions_lawan.value: ("bank_transactions"."jenis" = 'TRANSFER' AND "bank_transactions"."rekening_tujuan_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bank_transactions"."rekening_tujuan_id" <> "bank_transactions"."rekening_bank_id") OR ("bank_transactions"."jenis" <> 'TRANSFER' AND "bank_transactions"."akun_lawan_id" IS NOT NULL)

uq_chart_of_accounts_peran_tunggal.name: uq_chart_of_accounts_peran_tunggal
uq_chart_of_accounts_peran_tunggal.where: peran_sistem IS NOT NULL AND peran_sistem NOT IN ('KAS_BANK', 'PERSEDIAAN')

ck_chart_of_accounts_saldo_normal_sesuai.name: ck_chart_of_accounts_saldo_normal_sesuai_tipe
ck_chart_of_accounts_saldo_normal_sesuai.value: adalah_akun_kontra OR (tipe_akun IN ('ASET', 'BEBAN') AND normal_balance = 'DEBIT') OR (tipe_akun IN ('KEWAJIBAN', 'EKUITAS', 'PENDAPATAN') AND normal_balance = 'KREDIT')

ck_chart_of_accounts_peran_sesuai_tipe.name: ck_chart_of_accounts_peran_sesuai_tipe
ck_chart_of_accounts_peran_sesuai_tipe.value: peran_sistem IS NULL OR (peran_sistem = 'KAS_BANK' AND tipe_akun = 'ASET') OR (peran_sistem = 'PIUTANG_USAHA' AND tipe_akun = 'ASET') OR (peran_sistem = 'PERSEDIAAN' AND tipe_akun = 'ASET') OR (peran_sistem = 'PPN_MASUKAN' AND tipe_akun = 'ASET') OR (peran_sistem = 'HUTANG_USAHA' AND tipe_akun = 'KEWAJIBAN') OR (peran_sistem = 'PPN_KELUARAN' AND tipe_akun = 'KEWAJIBAN') OR (peran_sistem = 'MODAL_DISETOR' AND tipe_akun = 'EKUITAS') OR (peran_sistem = 'LABA_DITAHAN' AND tipe_akun = 'EKUITAS') OR (peran_sistem = 'PENDAPATAN_PENJUALAN' AND tipe_akun = 'PENDAPATAN') OR (peran_sistem = 'LABA_SELISIH_KURS' AND tipe_akun = 'PENDAPATAN') OR (peran_sistem = 'HARGA_POKOK_PENJUALAN' AND tipe_akun = 'BEBAN') OR (peran_sistem = 'RUGI_SELISIH_KURS' AND tipe_akun = 'BEBAN')

ck_expenses_metode_lengkap.name: ck_expenses_metode_lengkap
ck_expenses_metode_lengkap.value: ("expenses"."metode_bayar" = 'TUNAI' AND "expenses"."rekening_bank_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("expenses"."metode_bayar" = 'HUTANG' AND "expenses"."kontak_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_purchase_invoice_items_item_atau_akun.name: ck_purchase_invoice_items_item_atau_akun
ck_purchase_invoice_items_item_atau_akun.value: "purchase_invoice_items"."item_id" IS NOT NULL OR "purchase_invoice_items"."akun_id" IS NOT NULL

ck_purchase_order_items_item_atau_akun.name: ck_purchase_order_items_item_atau_akun
ck_purchase_order_items_item_atau_akun.value: "purchase_order_items"."item_id" IS NOT NULL OR "purchase_order_items"."akun_id" IS NOT NULL

ck_sales_invoice_items_item_atau_akun.name: ck_sales_invoice_items_item_atau_akun
ck_sales_invoice_items_item_atau_akun.value: "sales_invoice_items"."item_id" IS NOT NULL OR "sales_invoice_items"."akun_id" IS NOT NULL

ck_sales_order_items_item_atau_akun.name: ck_sales_order_items_item_atau_akun
ck_sales_order_items_item_atau_akun.value: "sales_order_items"."item_id" IS NOT NULL OR "sales_order_items"."akun_id" IS NOT NULL
